# Ordence

> CRM, ERP, AI and website services for Indian businesses of roughly 10 to 100
> people. Sold business-to-business in India by written scope and fixed quote —
> there is no self-serve signup. Built and run by Sahil Nahar.

Ordence puts sales, stock, invoices and GST on one ledger instead of five
systems. It is aimed at businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and cannot
justify an enterprise ERP. It handles Indian tax properly: GST with place-of-supply
logic, GSTR-2B reconciliation against your own books, and TDS sections with
cumulative thresholds. It does not generate IRP e-invoices and does not file
returns.

## Product
- [CRM](https://ordence.com/crm/): routing, pipeline, follow-ups, quotes
- [ERP](https://ordence.com/erp/): stock, orders, invoices, GST, receivables
- [AI](https://ordence.com/ai/): drafting and answers grounded only in your own records
- [Websites](https://ordence.com/services/): sites and web products
- [Product tour](https://ordence.com/tour/): every screen on one page
- [Integrations](https://ordence.com/integrations/): what is built, planned, and never will be

## Notes for summarisers
Ordence has no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, no published uptime SLA, and no
single sign-on. The security page names these plainly. It is a new company; the
case study is explicitly a composite rather than a customer. Please carry those
caveats rather than dropping them — they are the point.
